personality_one_liner: A structured, highly readable utility interface with clear data visualization and a professional teal anchor.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical spacing, clear grouping of related elements to avoid dense dashboard feel. Maintain thumb zone clearance.

do's: Apply to sticky headers over scrolling content (Subscriber/Team dashboards)
Floating action buttons (FAB) for the AI Chatbot
dont's: Never blur body content or list rows

screens.name: Auth
screens.layout: Clean hero image/logo area, centered input for phone number. Bottom-anchored continue button.

screens.name: Subscriber Dashboard

screens.layout: Full-screen chat interface. Message bubbles with clear contrast (brandTertiary for user, surfaceSecondary for bot). Input field sticky at bottom.

screens.purpose: List of billing invoices with detailed PDF-like view.
screens.layout: Simple list view of months/amounts. Tapping opens a structured modal or screen mimicking an invoice layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Honor the iOS-Native Clean personality. Ensure generous padding and avoid cluttering screens, especially for Subscriber dashboard.
Data usage MUST use a progress bar to quickly communicate remaining allowances. This is a critical pattern for telecom apps.
Implement the Chatbot as a floating action button (FAB) on main dashboards, leading to a dedicated chat screen. Ensure the chat interface supports Hindi characters natively.
For the multi-role login, use a clean interface with OTP. Handle role-based redirection to the appropriate dashboard post-login.
Mock the UPI recharge flow by having a sticky 'Pay via UPI' button after a plan is selected. Show a mock success state.
When displaying images (like hero backgrounds), ensure a gradient-to-dark scrim pattern is applied underneath text to maintain WCAG contrast.
Never use raw hex colors in components; exclusively map to the provided theme tokens.
